title: Brand mark
responsibility: Draws the modular Harness H using the surrounding text color.

inputs.name: BrandMark.size
inputs.description: Optional SVG width and height as number or string, default 1em.

inputs.name: BrandMark.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name, empty by default. Nonempty makes the SVG a named image; otherwise it is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

outputs.name: BrandMark
outputs.description: Nonfocusable tiled H SVG using shared tile geometry and currentColor. Supplies no navigation behavior.
